    All Classes and Interfaces

    Classes
    Class
    Description
    Armor
    A salable armor item with a defense rating.
    Health
    A salable healing item that restores health points during combat.
    InventoryManager
    Manages the arena store's stock using an array of SalableProduct objects.
    SalableProduct
    Represents an item sold at the Arena Supply Store.
    ShoppingCart
    Maintains a store shopper's selected quantities for each salable product.
    StoreFront
    Runs the console-based Arena Supply Store for the game user.
    Weapon
    A salable weapon with an attack damage rating.
